genuine_requirement: 10cm is the existing state-representation tolerance; do not silently rename it a learned sensor standard deviation. Clothing/wardrobe views must refine, moved chair must leave no old-site ghost.
unchanged_structure: Keep same copy/reference surfaces, physical identity, and P05 confidence. P07 majority is a later item.
current_query: Hash cells width10cm; only3x3x3 neighbors, early stop on any distance<=10cm. Exact Boolean within-radius query, not exact globally nearest distance.
implementation_implication: A continuous distance model needs its query support derived from the measurement model. Do not keep an undocumented hard search-radius tail cutoff or quadratic all-pairs query.
available_scale: Existing map_resolution can describe voxel uncertainty; geometry quantization approximation must be made explicit and validated. No new fitted bandwidth or GT-selected value.
dependency_fact: Project CMake currently explicitly asks PCL common/io only; avoid an unplanned dependency/framework expansion.

candidate_derivation.measurement_model: Retain T=0.10m as the state correspondence event. Approximate each reconstructed surface radial position by a uniform cell-phase error at the existing map resolution r; their difference has triangular support [-r,r]. Integrate the event d+error<=T instead of turning T into an undocumented Gaussian sigma.
candidate_derivation.cdf: u=(T-d)/r; p_near=0 if u<=-1, 0.5*(1+u)^2 if -1<u<0, 1-0.5*(1-u)^2 if0<=u<1, 1 ifu>=1. Uniform-cell assumption is a radial approximation, not exact anisotropic 3D noise.
candidate_derivation.query_support: Only reference points with distance<T+r can have nonzero correspondence likelihood. Use existing hash structure with cell widthT+r and27 neighboring cells, keeping nearest distance. Early return p1 is valid at d<=T-r. These bounds follow finite noise support and are not fitted clipping thresholds.
candidate_derivation.aggregation: Existing same copy vertices and off-share mean of1-p_near; no resampling, density weighting or changed P07 majority.
candidate_derivation.required_validation: Existing same-state tests then3RScanB to catch wrong static multi-view joins, then realB. ReuseA and no-call first-session datasets. No change before current P05 disposition.
candidate_derivation.risk: State discretization error may not describe actual TSDF vertex displacement; original purpose is protocol correspondence tolerance, so inspect each object and GT, not only aggregate score.
